record.reason: In a content-moderation skill-bundle harness (n=200), the selected configuration removes 38.1% of bundle content and 10.4% of runtime tokens; compressed accuracy is 89% versus 91–92% in uncompressed baselines. The evaluated object is agent skill/prompt content, not model weights or serving infrastructure, and evidence is from one application.
record.title: SkillZip Pro: Execution-Aware Dynamic Compression of Progressively Loaded Skills for Self-Evolving Agents
